item.title: In its debut collection, Vazaneh redefines what power dressing can feel like
item.description: In a fashion landscape often dominated by spectacle, Vazaneh’s first couture outing chooses restraint over noise. Titled Vazaneh: The First, the collection arrives not as a proclamation, but as a study of presence, emotion, and the evolving language of modern femininity. At its core, the collection reflects a shift in how power is expressed through clothing. Here, it is not found in volume or ornamentation alone, but in precision.
